children: News Corp disclosed progress under its US$1 billion 2025 repurchase program, having repurchased about US$483,393,387 of Class A and Class B shares.
Daily ASX notifications filed for buy-backs of Nasdaq-listed Class A and Class B shares under the 2025 Repurchase Program.
The program authorizes up to US$1 billion of repurchases; to date ~US$483,393,387 has been spent.
On 17/09/2026 the company bought 12,067,301 Class A shares for US$314,814,001.70 and 54,641 Class B shares for US$1,654,491.23.
Recent daily totals include purchases on 17/09/2026 of 5,621,283 Class A shares for US$166,129,749.31 and 23,784 Class B shares for US$795,144.31.
Repurchases are in USD, executed via broker Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, intended to enhance shareholder value; prices paid varied by date.
